description: Provision an Azure Web SitesSourcecontrol via Azure Service Operator. Fields mirror the web.azure.com/v1api20220301 SitesSourcecontrol spec.

branch.description: Branch: Name of branch to use for deployment.

credentialFrom.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding the Azure credential to use for this resource. Rendered as the serviceoperator.azure.com/credential-from annotation. Leave empty to inherit the credential from the namespace, then from the operator's global credential. The resource's subscription and resource group come from spec.owner, not from this field.
credentialFrom.title: Azure credential Secret

deploymentRollbackEnabled.description: DeploymentRollbackEnabled: true to enable deployment rollback; otherwise, false.

gitHubActionConfiguration.description: GitHubActionConfiguration: If GitHub Action is selected, than the associated configuration.

runtimeStack.description: RuntimeStack: Runtime stack is used to determine the workflow file content for code base apps.

runtimeVersion.description: RuntimeVersion: Runtime version is used to determine what build version to set in the workflow file.

imageName.description: ImageName: The image name for the build.

password.description: Password: The password used to upload the image to the container registry.

key.description: Key is the key in the Kubernetes secret being referenced

name.description:
Name is the name of the Kubernetes secret being referenced.
The secret must be in the same namespace as the resource

serverUrl.description: ServerUrl: The server URL for the container registry where the build will be hosted.

username.description: Username: The username used to upload the image to the container registry.

generateWorkflowFile.description:
GenerateWorkflowFile: Workflow option to determine whether the workflow file should be generated and written to the
repository.

isLinux.description: IsLinux: This will help determine the workflow configuration to select.

isGitHubAction.description: IsGitHubAction: true if this is deployed via GitHub action.

isManualIntegration.description: IsManualIntegration: true to limit to manual integration; false to enable continuous integration (which configures webhooks into online repos like GitHub).

isMercurial.description: IsMercurial: true for a Mercurial repository; false for a Git repository.

operatorSpec.description:
OperatorSpec: The specification for configuring operator behavior. This field is interpreted by the operator and not
passed directly to Azure

configMapExpressions.description: ConfigMapExpressions: configures where to place operator written dynamic ConfigMaps (created with CEL expressions).

items.description:
DestinationExpression is a CEL expression and a destination to store the result in. The destination may
be a secret or a configmap. The value of the expression is stored at the specified location in
the destination.

annotations.description: Annotations is an optional set of annotations to apply to the destination resource.

key.description:
Key is the key in the ConfigMap or Secret being written to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a string
this is required to identify what key to write to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a map[string]string
Key must not be set, instead the keys written will be determined dynamically based on the keys of the resulting
map[string]string.

labels.description: Labels is an optional set of labels to apply to the destination resource.

name.description:
Name is the name of the Kubernetes configmap or secret to write to.
The configmap or secret will be created in the same namespace as the resource.

value.description:
Value is a CEL expression. The CEL expression may return a string or a map[string]string. For more information
on CEL in ASO see https://azure.github.io/azure-service-operator/guide/expressions/
